profile_path.description: The base directory where Psi stores user data, preferences, and logs for this profile.

username.description: The Linux system username, used to construct default paths or identify the profile context.

initial_status.description: The presence status to set on startup. Valid values: online, chat, away, xa, dnd, offline.

initial_status_message.description: The custom status message to display alongside the initial status.

autologin.description: Whether to automatically log in to configured accounts on startup.

offline_msgs.description: Whether to retrieve offline messages upon connection.

muc_enabled.description: Whether to enable Multi-User Chat (MUC) support.

accounts.description: A list of account configurations to load into Psi profiles section [account.N]. Each account is a flat map of account settings. Do not nest this list further; just provide a list of objects matching the `items` schema below.
